notes.title: V2.2.5 Changelog: AI improved
notes.content:
Bugfix: AI decision-making improved in rare edge cases with certain settings

Bugfix: Resolved issue that prevented AI from making valid moves, which could cause jokers to remain in hand or lead to suboptimal plays

notes.title: Hotfix V2.2.2
notes.content: Bugfix: If Playing around the corner was activated, in certain cases, sequences with a low Ace were not scored correctly

notes.title: V2.2 Changelog
notes.content:
Bugfix: Fixed issue when rule setting 1st Allow multi sets was deactivated
 Bugfix: Fixed issue with special setting Allow stealing Jokers deactivated
 AI improved and multithreaded
 Other fixes

notes.title: V2.1.1 Changelog
notes.content:
Bugfix: AI discarded cards that could have been played on already placed cards
 Bugfix: MP scoring was locked to Rummy 500
 Bugfix: Adding several cards of the same rank to a set while replacing a Joker did not work in one turn
 Bugfix: Crashing (with NO stealing jokers, ALLOW double suit, adding to others ALWAYS set)

notes.title: Major Update V2.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35036775/0ee0ce802ade75e371e23add64e1daef222854ff.jpg

New Rule Variants

 Initial meld can now consist of multiple sets and runs
 Adjustable joker count
 Deck size customizable – e.g., mini deck with 32 cards
 Adjustable number of decks
 New options for minimum initial meld score: 45 and 50 points
 Options for when players can lay off on opponents’ melds
 Option to require a run in the initial meld
 Variant where players can only draw from the pile during the first round
 All new rule variants are also available in multiplayer mode

Bugfixes

 Fixed: Joker can now be placed at the start or end of a run
 Fixed: Multiplayer freeze issue

New Features

 Two large card face options – ranks are larger and easier to read (e.g., for Steam Deck)
 Support for ultrawide screen resolutions (up to 2.5:1 aspect ratio)

notes.title: V1.6.1 Hotfix: Fixed Multiplayer Freeze Bug
notes.content: Hotfix: In multiplayer melding a set with a Joker, having several Jokers on the hand, could lead to MP game not going for one player, such as: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3158795192)

notes.title: V1.4.2 Screen Resolutions and Linux fixes
notes.content:
Bugfix screen resolution scaling (for screen scaling > 100%)
 Bugfix startup crash on Linux (loading textures crash and wrong textures fixed)
 3:2 resolutions added

notes.title: V1.3.1 Multiplayer Bugfixes
notes.content:
Multiplayer Game Bugfixes


 fixed: Bug causing inconsistency errors LAN+Internet (which could happen since V1.2.2, if in multiplayer Adding Cards to others and Stealing Jokers option was activated)
 fixed: when in MP 1st dealer was set = Random, in some cases bug could cause game not starting or with wrong players' cards
 fixed: In special cases using the new Restart button caused RangeError or crash

notes.title: Major Update V1.2 released
notes.content:
Update 1.2.0

+ Rummy 500 scoring added
+ Visualization for cards added to others' sets and correct scoring
+ New: Undo button
+ Option: Playing without jokers
+ Option: Number of cards dealt adjustable
+ New variation: Knock Rummy
+ Option: Number cards count 5 points or face value
+ Option: Ascending or descending order of cards
+ All rule variations available in multiplayer
+ Start modes Safe Mode and Autoconfig Mode added
+/- Stealing of Jokers from others by replacing removed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35036775/a4717b73a06d299e2525a49cf3b48adcc872e778.jpg

Rummy 3D Premium development combines both:
- Rummy and European Rommé and Rami game rule variants
- Singleplayer and Multiplayer

notes.title: Join the free Betatest until Sunday, May 1st
notes.content:
Beta of upcoming major update V1.2 is online!

You can join the beta playtest until Sunday, May 1st and play the beta until Update Release.

Just click on Request Access button on store page to join the playtest.

Some of the new features:
- Rummy 500 scoring
- correct scoring and visualization for cards added to others' sets
- undo button
- more rule variations
- all rule variations available in multiplayer

notes.title: Major Update May 2022
notes.content:
Rummy and European Rommé are based on same principal rules, but rule variations differ. 

Problem that only positive or negative scoring is possible will be resolved by the update.
Common Rummy 500 +/- scoring will be integrated with +melds and -deadwood (hand cards) points.

notes.title: Released now - Tips here!
notes.content:
SUPPORTED RUMMY VARIATIONS
- Specify Rummy rules in Singleplayer by clicking "Rules" Button on top

GAMEPLAY
- Discard with one right mouse-click
- Where is the drawn card sorted?
in "Rules" you can pre-define, such as to the left, to the right and other.
Default setting "Automatically" places drawn card next to similar cards.

FEEL FREE
to discuss anything, Rummy is a game of uncountable
